title: Monastery of Ashen Bells
intent: A compact enclosed monastery wraps a high garden, with a detached bell stair on the east and catacombs below the north range. Its service path and terraces distinguish it from the urban academy.

links.construction: West catacomb stair in its own shaft; avoid crossing beneath the north stair. Measured 5.4m ascending flight, 1.5m clear width and authored level connections.

staging.logistics: Van is already staged on a prepared roadhead/service apron through expedition logistics. Travel to this remote region is a campaign transition; no new vehicle, ferry or flight gameplay is assumed.

circulation: Cloister and garden are the main surface loop; service terrace links refectory to tower base. Catacombs have two independent descents. Bell chamber is a short observation branch with no required rite above a single stair.
systems: Windward bell tower, still garden and stone underground have contrasting acoustics. Bell events require a physical bell/striker and lawful cause; the ledger is narrative, not a guaranteed supernatural reading.
campaign: Silence, missing community records and an impossible toll ledger can connect to cemetery parish gaps. Monastic practice itself is not evidence of evil.
refine: Inspect monastery and bell-frame structural references before detailed shell work.
Preserve the open cloister void; never cap the garden with an inferred roof.
Engineer tower flights and two catacomb entries; all core rituals remain below tower level.
